problem: Given a sorted integer array a and an integer X, determine whether there exist two distinct elements whose sum is exactly X. Return YES or NO. N can be up to 2e5.
You are given a sorted array. Find the minimum absolute difference between the sum of two distinct elements and a target T. N can be 2e5.
Given heights of vertical lines, find the maximum area of a container formed by choosing two lines.
Given a string, determine whether it reads the same from left to right and right to left after removing non-alphanumeric characters and ignoring case.
Given a sorted array of distinct integers and K, determine whether there are i < j such that a[j] - a[i] = K. Return one valid pair of original 1-based indices.
Given an array, remove all occurrences of value X in-place while preserving the relative order of the remaining elements. Return the new logical length.
Given a sorted array, keep at most two copies of each value in-place and return the resulting length.
Merge two already sorted arrays into the first array in nondecreasing order. The destination has enough unused capacity at the end.
Given a string, find the length of the longest contiguous substring containing at most K distinct characters. N up to 2e5.
Given an array of positive integers and S, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least S. Return 0 if none exists.
Given a binary array, find the longest contiguous segment containing at most K zeros.
Given an array of nonnegative integers, find the longest contiguous subarray whose sum is at most S.
Rearrange an array in-place so that all negative values come before all nonnegative values. The relative order inside each group does not matter.
Given an array containing only 0, 1, and 2, sort it in-place in linear time and constant extra space.
Given a singly linked list, determine whether it contains a cycle using O(1) extra space.
Given a singly linked list, return its middle node. For even length, return the second middle node. Use O(1) extra space.
Given an integer array containing both negative and positive values, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least S. N up to 2e5.
Given an unsorted array, find whether two elements sum to X. Original order must remain unchanged and sorting the input is forbidden.
You have an array with point updates and range minimum queries. Both updates and queries occur online.
Given N arbitrary integers, determine whether some subset (not necessarily contiguous and not limited to two elements) sums to T. N can be 40.
Given a sorted array and Q independent queries, return the first index whose value is at least X. N,Q up to 2e5.
Given an arbitrary integer sequence, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
Given an array, determine whether any value occurs more than once. N up to 2e5. No ordering requirement.
Given N static values and Q range-sum queries, return the sum for each [L,R].
Given intervals, select the maximum number of mutually non-overlapping intervals.
Given a matrix of positive weights, move only right or down from the top-left to the bottom-right and minimize total cost.
Given an unsorted array and target T, return the original 1-based indices of two distinct values summing to T. The output can be in any order. Sorting is allowed if original indices can be restored.
Given a sorted array with many duplicate values, find whether there exists a pair whose sum is T. Return YES/NO only.
Given up to 2e5 heights, each up to 1e9, find the maximum container area. Use a 64-bit-safe implementation.
Given a sorted array of length 0 or more and target T, find two distinct positions with sum T, if they exist. Inputs include empty arrays, one-element arrays, and no-solution cases.
A sorted list of package weights is given. Determine whether two distinct packages have total weight exactly W. Do not reorder the list.
A log stream is represented as a string. Find the longest contiguous block containing no more than K different event types.
An array must be compacted in place so that every item satisfying predicate P occupies the first part of the array, preserving the order of kept items.
A sorted list is given, but each query inserts or deletes values before asking whether a pair sums to T. There are 2e5 online updates and queries.
Given an array of nonnegative integers, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum is at most S. N up to 2e5.
Given an array of integers, count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals S. Values may be negative, zero, or positive.
Given two sorted arrays, find whether they share a common value. Return YES or NO.
Given two unsorted arrays, determine whether they share a common value. Sorting is allowed and N,M up to 2e5.
Given a string, find the shortest substring containing every character from a required set at least once.
Given an array of integers, find the longest contiguous subarray with sum exactly S. All values are positive.
